text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the camp, I saw Air Groove talking 
to Agnes Tachyon. ...There were some 
rather suspicious devices lying around 
them—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon. Could you at least refrain from 
conducting shady experiments during the 
training camp?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oops, Air Groove? No, no, there's nothing 
suspicious going on here at all. You see, 
this is—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm preparing a barbecue! You might 
see flasks and test tubes lying around, 
but those are just for concocting my 
secret sauce.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. As a legitimate member of the 
academy, you'll vouch for me too, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...If any problem occurs, I'll stop it 
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Phew... You're keeping as sharp an eye on 
me as ever, huh? Well, let's pull 
ourselves together and keep going.
choice_data_list:
Are you really planning to have a 
barbecue...?

Are you really planning to have a 
barbecue...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No way—er, no, that's exactly it! Let us 
begin our preparations immediately. Now, 
do your best, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A barbecue was suddenly decided upon, and 
for some reason, I ended up scrambling to 
make preparations.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, whoa, what's with the long faces? 
This is supposed to be a fun, wonderful 
barbecue."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Did you perhaps mean a rugged, 
treacherous... barbecue...?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Look who's talking. Even though I went out 
of my way to prepare top-quality 
ingredients for you all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Behold. Let's see, carrots, potatoes, 
green peppers, corn...—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's this? An eggplant? ...I guess 
it's an eggplant. Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Why are you being vague too!? That's 
terrifying!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that, like always... something 
weird has been mixed into it...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, you're hopeless. Well then, 
Trainer-kun. Feel free to taste for 
poison— I mean, take the first bite, go 
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Here, say aaaah.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "How is it? How does it taste?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... You're right. It's delicious.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey!? Even Suzuka... Why are you casually 
eating it too?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...Dammit! This makes it look like I got 
no guts! I'll do it!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, didn't I tell you from the 
start it would be a fun barbecue? Do you 
really distrust me that much?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come now, you eat some too, Cafe. You must 
be tired, right? Build up your strength.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Just a single bite, okay...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the barbecue hosted by Agnes 
Tachyon turned out to be quite lively—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well now, that turned out to be quite a 
splendid event! You worked exceptionally 
hard as well, Trainer-kun!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks to that, I was able to dispose of 
the experimental data by incineration 
quite naturally.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The student council had their eyes on me, 
after all. I needed to dispose of anything 
compromising in a way that wouldn't arouse 
suspicion.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, in that respect, barbecues are great. 
The grill burned everything right to 
ashes. Ahaha!
choice_data_list: That was a close call, huh?
I ended up helping destroy the evidence...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, in that respect, barbecues are great. 
The grill burned everything right to 
ashes. Ahaha!
choice_data_list: That was a close call, huh?
I ended up helping destroy the evidence...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you see. There are still a few 
more documents left that need to be 
disposed of.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"You're already in the same boat as me. 
—Of course you'll cooperate in taking care 
of this, won't you?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Good, good. That's my guinea pig for you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, things have been tough 
lately. We've been forced to make a major 
pivot from our original plans.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, that's a rather scandalous way 
of putting it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, my wonderful research 
didn't have to be interrupted. Hold your 
head up higher with pride.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —As my "accomplice," that is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, things have been tough 
lately. We've been forced to make a major 
pivot from our original plans.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
“—Well, ever since encountering a certain 
uncertain factor, everything I had planned 
has been slowly swallowed into unknown 
chaos.”
choice_data_list: What do you mean by that...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Nothing much. Just thinking about how 
much fun this really is."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon gazed into the dying embers 
and remnants of data. The flames reflected 
in her eyes seemed to grow fiercer and 
deeper red.
